responsibility: Declares the known-header lookup APIs and the deferred diagnostic class used for missing-include suggestions. It exposes functions for mapping common C/C++ standard names and string macros to headers, and the suggest_missing_header helper that carries an optional follow-up note and include fix-it for undeclared-name diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public lookup functions and the suggest_missing_header deferred-diagnostic class used by clients, while known-headers.cc contains the actual standard-library header hint tables, lookup routines, and diagnostic-emission method definitions.
